lessons.headline: L A  E S C U E L I T A
intro: For anyone who wants to pick up the guitar or ukulele, Projectodo offers music lessons in their music school in Berlin for beginners and advanced players.
Lessons in small groups are just as possible as private one-on-one instruction, and can also be arranged at your home upon request.
benefits: Even in early childhood, musical education fosters concentration and cognitive performance through play – self-confidence is strengthened and a new world of creativity is opened.
Especially hyperactive children benefit, as they learn to concentrate and reduce aggression through music.
Senior citizens also gain significant benefits from learning to play an instrument, as playing music is like exercise for the brain.
